suite.description: Hand-authored outputs and labels over invented services. No host, model or provider was run. Monetary and timing values are illustrative.
suite.annotation: Fixture author supplied gold answers, answer matches, semantic citation labels and report rubric scores. These are not independent human or model ratings.

Brook supports search and extraction through reusable sessions. Session lifetime is not specified.

tasks.prompt: Using the four frozen fixture records, list every service whose available documentation explicitly supports search, extraction and reusable sessions. Preserve unavailable/uncertain cases.

rubric.answer_matching: A human or explicitly identified model matches each atomic predicted service to one gold entity by identity, accounting for aliases and scope. Use null for an incorrect or unsupported entity; leave unjudged answers absent. Duplicate matches to one gold entity count once under set metrics.
rubric.citation_support: For each unique claim/source pair, read the actual quoted context and verify entity, time and scope. supported means the text supports the entire claim; unsupported means it contradicts or does not support the claim; uncertain means ambiguity or insufficient context prevents a reliable judgment. A substring/regex match alone is not support. Both unsupported and uncertain remain in the full accuracy denominator.

report_quality.factuality: 0: pervasive unsupported conclusions; 1: major errors; 2: mixed support; 3: minor qualified issues; 4: claims supported within the fixture scope.
report_quality.completeness: 0: misses the task; 1: most required answers absent; 2: partial set; 3: complete answers with a minor omission in limitations; 4: complete set plus original-scope gaps.
report_quality.uncertainty: 0: hides limitations; 1: misleading certainty; 2: some uncertainty stated; 3: most gaps identified; 4: unavailable sources, ambiguity and bounds all clear.
